summary: Current main served identical deterministic outputs after Decode-only and Prefill-only replacement in a constrained real NIXL UCX P/D run on one gfx950. No production source change was justified. Upstream PR 34289 is open, absent from this checkout, targets a stable-service Prefill replacement case, and explicitly leaves Decode replacement unresolved.

tests.what_was_measured: Real source-checkout NIXL UCX P/D HTTP execution on one gfx950: baseline, Decode replacement, pair restart control, and Prefill replacement all returned HTTP 200 with completion IDs [12,100,124,43,124,43,124,51].
Independent Transformers GPU generation for the same deterministic fixture and prompt produced completion IDs [12,100,124,43,124,43,124,51].
54 focused disaggregation tests and 2 subtests passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 real Prefill/Decode logs and HTTP responses are in evidence/single_gpu_nixl_skip_warmup; evidence/transformers_reference.json records the independent GPU output.

remaining_limitations: Only one assigned gfx950 was available, so Prefill and Decode shared a GPU instead of using one H100 per role.
The deterministic tiny random Llama validates transport and engine execution only; it does not qualify Qwen3-0.6B architecture or semantic accuracy.
Loopback UCX does not reproduce cross-node networking, Kubernetes stable-Service routing, draining old processes, or independent GPU failure domains.
The installed NIXL version/topology differs from the report's NIXL 1.3.2 deployment.
In-flight, overlapping, rapid repeated, and dynamically reconfigured router replacement cases were not exercised.
The first no-skip-warmup attempt remained HTTP 503 on Decode during built-in disaggregation warmup; its logs are retained but it did not reach the issue sequence.
